sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is the required canonical I2.3 ice-load patch relationship or controlled concept; the available patch classes and existing structural-member terms cannot semantically satisfy that missing relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph does not faithfully encode the comparison or design condition: a true memberCapacityMinimizationConfirmed flag and string-valued effect/location fields are only presence/confirmation approximations, with no explicit check that the ice-load patch is applied at a location minimizing member capacity under combined bending and shear or that the members withstand the patch. Add a bounded DIRECT_STATIC comparison/query or equivalent SHACL constraints linking the declared load-case operands and result, and encode the required patch/design relationship without inventing a convenience boolean.
